device_entry.name: Newport XPS精密运动控制器
tags: 实验室自动化与仪器集成
样品/探针定位与运动控制
device_entry.description: 这是一种用于精密位移与定位实验的网络化运动控制器，可驱动和协调电动位移台、线性/旋转执行器等设备。它常用于光学对准、样品定位、扫描测量和自动化实验平台，并可在控制器内部保存配置、程序或日志等文件供网络管理。
device_entry.description_en: This is a networked precision motion controller used for laboratory positioning and motion applications. It drives and coordinates motorized stages and linear or rotary actuators, and is commonly used for optical alignment, sample positioning, scanning measurements, and automated experimental platforms. The controller can also store configuration, program, or log files for network-based file management.
